summary: User 1001 registered and later de-registered cleanly.
rationale: User 1001: REGISTER (frame 1) was challenged with 401 (frame 2); the credentialed REGISTER (frame 3) was accepted with 200, Contact expires=3600 (frame 4). Its last REGISTER transaction is a de-registration: REGISTER with Expires 0 (frame 20) was challenged with 401 (frame 21); the credentialed REGISTER with Expires 0 (frame 22) was accepted with 200, Expires 0 (frame 23). Expected: a REGISTER with Expires 0 removes the binding (RFC 3261 §10.2.2). This is a de-registration, not a failure.
